about_the_game:
Sudoban is a block-pushing logic puzzle game. Fill highlighted lines of cells with uniquely numbered blocks by moving them and using them to push other blocks into place. Discover new strategies as you tackle hand-crafted puzzles carefully designed to engage and challenge your brain.

Key Features:

  • Enjoy hand-crafted puzzles spanning 4x4, 6x6, and 9x9 grid sizes!

  • Sink into puzzle-solving bliss with a tranquil acoustic fingerstyle guitar soundtrack!

  • Enjoy a minimalist design with a plethora of pre-made themes. Can't find your perfect theme? Build your own, customized exactly to your liking!

  • Take breaks at your leisure and seamlessly pick up puzzles where you left them!

  • Utilize built-in tools designed to help you solve Sudoban's puzzles, such as the marker tool, which allows you to mark the candidate spaces for a block.

  • Play the game your way, whether that's a controller, keyboard, mouse, or touch.

short_description: Embark on a serene puzzle journey with Sudoban, a fresh twist on the beloved logic puzzle! Carefully maneuver numbered blocks to fill rows and columns, solving hand-crafted minimalistic puzzles. Unwind, challenge your mind, and embrace the tranquil joy of logical problem-solving!
